description: React component for managing and displaying evaluations, including listing, creating, deleting, and viewing evaluation details with nested evaluation runs.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches evaluation data for the current page and limit.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles pagination page and limit changes.

methods.name: onSelectAllClick
methods.description: Selects or deselects all evaluation rows.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of individual evaluation rows.

methods.name: createEvaluation
methods.description: Opens dialog to create a new evaluation.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation of creating a new evaluation.

methods.name: goToDataset
methods.description: Opens dataset details in a new tab.

methods.name: onSelectAllChildClick
methods.description: Selects or deselects all child evaluations in a nested row.

methods.name: handleSelectChild
methods.description: Handles selection of individual child evaluations.

methods.name: deleteChildEvaluations
methods.description: Deletes selected child evaluations after confirmation.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns color based on evaluation status.

methods.name: getPassRateColor
methods.description: Returns color based on pass percentage.
